Refs #409. Not closing yet: this changes what the model and the transcript see, so it needs a live Pi check first.

## Reproduction

The issue gives enough to reproduce this without the session file. Its step 4 test is the trigger: a completed assistant message whose last text line is an `[Pit: elided tool call…]` record and that has no `toolCall` block. Before this change, Pit's `turn_end` boundary returned nothing for such a message, so the run settled with no tool result and no notice. The new test `test/globals/imitated-calls.test.ts` builds that exact message on
